turns.text: I want gold earrings I never have to take off. Shower, gym, office. Under ₹5k.

Look for 316L stainless steel or titanium with a PVD gold coating. PVD bonds much harder than regular plating, so it holds up to water and sweat. Hoops and huggies are the easiest shapes to sleep and shower in.
What size hoop works for both office and weekends?
Most people find 20 to 30mm hoops versatile enough for work. 40mm and above reads more as a statement. If you're unsure, check how far the hoop drops below the lobe.

turns.text: My college friend's wedding is in Jaipur next month. Gift ideas around ₹3–4k? She likes gold jewellery.

Jewellery is a lovely wedding-guest gift. Statement hoops or jhumkas work well across sangeet and reception looks. Pick something versatile she can re-wear, and check the return or exchange policy in case of duplicates.
Something that'll look good in photos but she can also wear later?
Polished gold hoops photograph well and stay wearable after the wedding. Kundan or pearl jhumkas are more festive. A gift note and wrap make it feel special.

turns.text: My ears itch with most fashion earrings. What should I look for in studs?

Itching is often a reaction to nickel. Look for posts in implant-grade titanium, niobium or solid gold, and avoid unspecified 'gold-toned' metals. Ask the brand what the post is made of, not just the front.
Any everyday gold studs like that?
Simple studs with titanium posts are a good start. Check that the brand states the post material clearly.
